name: Alchemy FM Channel Designer
author: MMagTech
description: Design live radio channels in AudioMuse using CLAP, lyrics, mood clusters, and Song Alchemy — preview programming, then deploy to Alchemy FM.

versions.changelog: Restyle the plugin settings page to match the Channel Designer. It never loaded the plugin stylesheet, so it rendered with raw browser defaults; the Backup & Restore panel now uses the same panels, fields and buttons as the rest of the plugin instead of inline styles. Cap the Your Stations list height once there are more than six stations so a large library no longer pushes the designer off-screen - nothing is hidden, the list scrolls in place, the filter still searches every station, and the heading now shows a station count.

Major release: station-intelligence features plus backup/restore. New Step 2 'Journey' programming type drifts a station from a start track toward an end mood across the day (AudioMuse find_path), looping each night. New Step 5 options: 'Smooth Transitions' orders each refill by harmonic/tempo compatibility (Camelot-style key + BPM), and 'Time-of-Day Energy (Daypart)' biases refills toward calmer or higher-energy tracks by the local hour. Settings gains Backup & Restore: download all channel designs and living pools as a JSON file (credentials excluded) and restore by merge-on-slug. The three playback features are executed by Alchemy FM on refill, so update the Alchemy FM backend to match this plugin.
